dedupe_keys.name: 3dom gnss iot a dataset for long term monitoring of small displacements of infrastructures with a low power iot based gnss device

description: A Fondazione Bruno Kessler team publishes raw low-cost GNSS logs for infrastructure-displacement monitoring. Zenodo provides rover and base-station archives plus a weather-station archive under CC BY 4.0. Two fixed receivers and antennas were attached to a short aluminium beam, and observations were collected at 1 Hz for about sixty days. The documentation identifies rover UBX streams and base-station observation and navigation files for GPS, Galileo and GLONASS. These time series can serve as calibration inputs in simulations of displacement monitoring for bridges or other assets. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experiment. Coverage is the test installation and its two-month campaign, not a surveyed network of failing structures. A limitation is that the stated fixed beam does not itself create a controlled displacement history; calibration and ground truth need checking before accuracy claims. The large archives were not downloaded and no coordinate series was recalculated.
